name: Advanced FileSystem
description: Enterprise file-management framework: pluggable path strategies, batch migration with dry-run and rollback, orphan detection, retention rules, deduplication, integrity checks, ghost-file scanner, URL rewriting and a file report. Ships 26 submodules for backup, AI, antivirus, CDN, quota and processors.

suggests.drupal/ai: ^1.0 — required by advanced_filesystem_ai_transcription for speech-to-text and image-to-text.
suggests.ext-exif: required by advanced_filesystem_metadata for EXIF extraction from images.
suggests.ext-gd: required by advanced_filesystem_smart_image for image transformations.

project_description: Advanced FileSystem turns Drupal's file storage into a manageable, observable subsystem. Its lean core provides a pluggable path-strategy API (13 built-in strategies) that controls where uploaded files land on disk, a batch migration tool with dry-run preview, confirmation and rollback, a detailed file report with filters and CSV/JSON export, an integrity checker and ghost-file scanner, on-upload processing hooks (filename sanitization, duplicate-name resolution, EXIF stripping, exact/perceptual duplicate detection), embedded-URL rewriting after a migration, and background services that watch for orphans, record storage growth, enforce retention rules and deduplicate content. All administration is gated behind a single restricted permission. The project also ships 26 optional submodules (documented separately) covering backup, AI, antivirus, CDN, quota, metadata extraction and media processors.
